column1: # Controls of the mainline sun4i-codec card "Codec" as bound for the A133
# ("allwinner,sun50i-a133-codec" -> H616 card, "H616 Audio Codec"), read from
# the driver source at the kernel pin below (bd tsp-f3fm.220).
#   commit: bea8779b08a8679000cd9036ba9c86ae4b057cc8  (platform.lock kernel-sunxi-7.x pin; the tsp-f3fm.215 P4 image kernel)
# Complete for this card: the H616 codec component controls (plain and DAPM
# mixer/mux) plus the card's one pin switch. The TSP DTS's aux speaker amp
# (simple-audio-amplifier with only enable-gpios) adds no controls.
# Names as ALSA shows them: the mixer switches are shared by Left/Right Mixer
# (SOC_MIXER_ARRAY over one array), so soc-dapm names them without a widget
# prefix. A mux control takes the widget name. SOC_DAPM_PIN_SWITCH("Speaker")
# Columns (TAB-separated): name, kind, spec, source line
